_doc: HW1 PlayEffect effect -> AE effect for SpawnEffect, and HW1 PlayGibs gib -> AE gore id (tweak/gore.sval) for SpawnGore. Effects were paired with the SpawnEffect AE's Castle Hammerwatch puts at the same spot (flash -> blink 14/14). A gib with no entry falls back on its name: sand/dust -> dust, wood -> crate_wood, rock/stone -> rock, otherwise blood_medium.
